newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - stronger crude boosts prices.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - stronger crude boosts prices.

text.p: NWE oil products all gained on the back of crude on Monday, traders said.
Gasoline was pulled higher by sharp gains in crude and unleaded futures.
Naphtha was dragged reluctantly higher by crude as sloppy supply continued to weigh on the markets.
Fuel oil barges were boosted by bidding, though failed to hold their highs of $85 fob. Low sulphur cargoes got mild support from crude, which triggered a $1 rise in swaps.
Gas oil was up $2 or so, mainly on the back of stronger futures, but also due in part to narrowly stronger premiums.
